comment: No source is published; the maker's manual is at factionoptions.com/manual. No output calls setChannels, so all seven are monophonic. The last four are lerped towards their new value with a coefficient of the sample time times four, and snap once the gap falls under 0.001, which is what the manual means by smoothed. The scalings the maker prints in the port names - 100ms, one part in ten, 50ms - are the divisors in the code, so the tooltip and the code agree.
